description: L298N DC motor demo: ENA = PA0 TIM2 1 kHz PWM, IN1/IN2 = PB0/PB1; fwd 25/50/75/100 %, brake, rev 50/100 %, coast, 400 ms each, USART1 log
expect: 72 MHz; TIM2 PSC 71, ARR 999: 1 kHz PWM on PA0 (AF push-pull), CCR1 = 10 x duty (preloaded), PB0/PB1 push-pull, both written with one BSRR store per phase. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1: 'L298N DC motor demo\r\n' then the first phase 'fwd 25%\r\n'; every 400 ms (HAL_GetTick deadlines, no drift) the next phase and its log line: fwd 25% (PB0=1 PB1=0, duty 25), fwd 50%, fwd 75%, fwd 100%, brake (PB0=PB1=0, duty 100), rev 50% (PB0=0 PB1=1), rev 100%, coast (duty 0), then again from fwd 25% (3.2 s per cycle). With an L298N (ENA jumper removed, VS 7.5 V) and a 130-size motor on OUT1/OUT2 the motor speeds up in four steps, brakes, runs in reverse and coasts down (PWM on ENA = drive / coast: an unloaded motor already turns fast at low duty).

circuit: PA0, PB0, PB1: L298N ENA / IN1 / IN2 in the full circuit (motor speed covered by tests/devices/motors-firmware.test.ts); unconnected on this bench
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
